news.title: ClickFix fake browser updates are tricking people into running malware — close the tab
news.excerpt: That "Update Chrome" or "Update Firefox" page that pops up while you're browsing? It's a lie. ClickFix scams mimic real browser updates to get you to copy-paste a malicious command into your terminal. Real browsers update themselves automatically — they never ask you to run commands. Close the tab. If it won't close, hold your power button for 15 seconds until the screen goes black, then turn it back on.

news.title: Scammers Are Faking Official-Looking Notices — Here's the Tell
news.excerpt:
Scammers Are Faking Official-Looking Notices — Here's the Tell.

You get an email or see a webpage that looks exactly like it's from
your bank, the IRS, or a government agency. The logo is perfect.
The formatting is perfect. It says "Immediate action required" and
threatens account closure, legal trouble, or lost benefits if you
don't respond today.

The giveaway: they ask for something no legitimate organization
would ever request by email. Your Social Security number. Your
bank login. A payment in gift cards or wire transfer. Remote access
to your computer.

Real banks and government agencies don't operate this way. They
already have your information. They don't threaten instant disaster.
They don't demand gift cards.

What to do: Don't click any links in the message. Don't call...

news.title: Password Manager Breach — mSecure Users Told to Change All Passwords
news.excerpt:
Password manager mSecure just told all users to change every password stored in their vault — but won't say what actually happened. On November 3, mSeven Software emailed customers about "suspicious activity" and said to immediately change passwords, reset two-factor authentication, and remove passkeys. They didn't say when it happened, what was accessed, or if your data was stolen. Because the scope is unknown, assume the worst: change your most important passwords first (email, banking, work) through each service's official website. Use a different, strong password for each. Consider moving to a different password manager until mSecure explains what happened.

Source: Malwarebytes — November 4–6, 2026

news.title: That 'Gift Card Payment' Demand Is a Scam — Hang Up
news.excerpt:
The phone rings. The caller says you owe money — taxes, a utility bill, a court fine — and the only way to pay today is with gift cards. "Go to the store, buy Apple or Google Play cards, read me the numbers on the back."

No real government agency or legitimate company asks for gift cards. Ever. Gift cards are for gifts. Once you read the numbers, the money is gone and you can't get it back.

What to do: Hang up. If you're worried you owe something, look up the official number yourself and call. Never pay anyone with gift cards. Never read card numbers to anyone on the phone.

The rule: Gift cards are for presents. If someone demands them as payment, it's a scam. Every single time.

Source: FTC.gov — October 2026

posts.title: Stop paying for video editors — DaVinci Resolve is free and beats most paid tools
posts.summary: DaVinci Resolve is the free video editor that Hollywood pros use. Edit, color grade, audio mix, and add effects — all free at davinciresolve.com. No watermark, no trial, no subscription.
posts.truth: Customers come in thinking they need Adobe Premiere at $20/month forever. I show them DaVinci Resolve and they're stunned. The free version handles editing, color, and audio for most home projects. The free version exports up to UHD 4K — Studio is needed for higher resolutions and some pro features.

posts.title: Tired of juggling Gmail Outlook and Yahoo? Thunderbird puts every account in one free app
posts.summary: Thunderbird is the free email app that puts Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, and every other account in one place. Download free at thunderbird.net — no subscription, works offline, respects your privacy.
posts.truth: I see people with three browser tabs open just to check email. Thunderbird pulls them all into one window with unified folders. You can search across every account at once. It's the only email app I use on my own machines.

posts.title: Columbia County emergency alerts — sign up free for storm and outage texts
posts.summary: Get emergency alerts for Columbia County texted to your phone free. Sign up through the ALERT Columbia County FLA portal linked from columbiacountyfla.com (Emergency Management page) — https://member.everbridge.net/index/453003085613883#/signup — you can get alerts by text, email, or phone for emergencies and severe weather at your address. You'll get tornado warnings, severe storm alerts, evacuation notices, and road closures before they hit the news.

posts.title: Get 25+ free Windows power tools in one install — Microsoft PowerToys at github.com/microsoft/PowerToys
posts.summary: Microsoft PowerToys gives you 25+ free utilities in one package: bulk file renamer, color picker, keyboard remapper, window manager, image resizer, and more. Install free from the Microsoft Store (search "PowerToys") or download at github.com/microsoft/PowerToys.
posts.truth: I install this on every customer PC that comes through the shop. The bulk renamer alone saves hours when someone has 500 photos named IMG_001 through IMG_500. The "Always on Top" window feature is a lifesaver for comparing documents side by side.

posts.title: Fake Windows update popup locks your screen — Microsoft never puts a phone number in an error
posts.summary: That "Critical Windows Update" popup with a 1-800 number is a scam. Microsoft never includes phone numbers in warnings. Close the browser tab (Ctrl+W). If it won't close, hold your power button for 15 seconds until the screen goes black, then turn it back on.

posts.title: **Headline:** Stop renting Microsoft Office for $100 a year — LibreOffice is free and opens every Word Excel PowerPoint file
posts.summary: Download LibreOffice free at libreoffice.org. It includes Writer (Word), Calc (Excel), Impress (PowerPoint), Draw, Base, and Math. Opens and saves Microsoft Office formats. No subscription, no account needed.
posts.truth: I install LibreOffice on every tune-up. Customers come back amazed they've been paying for Office when this does everything they need — letters, budgets, slideshows — for zero dollars.

posts.title: **Headline:** Windows Voice Typing (Win+H) types for you free — built into Windows 11
posts.summary: Press Win+H anywhere to dictate text — no install needed, works offline, handles punctuation commands like 'period' 'comma' 'new line'.
posts.truth: Most people don't realize Windows has had solid dictation for years — I show this to customers who struggle with typing and they're amazed it's free and already there.

posts.title: Windows Clipboard History (Win+V) remembers everything you copy — free built-in
posts.summary: Press Win+V to see your clipboard history — pin items you reuse, sync across your devices, clear with one click.
posts.truth: I watch people copy-paste the same thing five times a day — Win+V lets you grab yesterday's copied text instantly. It's the most underused Windows feature.

posts.title: Fake Antivirus Renewal Emails Steal Your Credit Card — Check Subscription Status Directly in the App
posts.summary: If an email says your Norton or McAfee subscription renewed for $80–$100, don't click the link. Open the security app on your computer or go to norton.com / mcafee.com directly to check your real status.
posts.truth: This scam works because antivirus renewals are confusing — the product came with the PC, someone else manages it, or you forgot. The email exploits that uncertainty. I see this come up regularly.
